apiKey.title: LargitData API key
apiKey.description: Your LargitData Social Media Data API key, sent as the auth-header header. Without a key the Actor returns one sample record only. Keys are issued after a trial request: https://www.largitdata.com/en/social-media-api/#api-inquiry

mode.title: What to collect
mode.description: Keyword search returns posts. Comments returns the comments/replies of one post (Post URL). Account timeline returns one account's posts (Author ID; Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Douyin and Threads only).

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword for Keyword search, in the platform's language (Simplified Chinese for Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, Zhihu and Tieba).

postUrl.title: Post URL
postUrl.description: URL of the post whose comments you want (Comments mode).

authorId.title: Author ID
authorId.description: Account ID on the platform (Account timeline mode).

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Required for Account timeline on Weibo, Xiaohongshu and Douyin; optional elsewhere.

maxPages.title: Max result pages to crawl
maxPages.description: How deep the collector goes on the platform (max_pages, or max_scroll on Threads). Larger values take longer.

includeReplies.title: Include second-level replies
includeReplies.description: Comments mode: also collect replies to comments where the platform supports it.

maxItems.title: Max items to save
maxItems.description: Stop after saving this many records to the dataset. 0 means no limit.

pollIntervalSecs.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSecs.description: How often to check whether the collection task has finished.

timeoutMins.title: Task timeout (minutes)
timeoutMins.description: Give up waiting after this long. The task keeps running on LargitData's side; re-run later to fetch it.
